variants.label: bright
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer edit.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET and exact composition reference, not loose inspiration.
Primary request: redraw this same full island diorama in deliberate 16-bit era pixel art, delivered as a LARGE high-resolution wide image, ideally 2048 x 1152, 16:9. This is for a full-screen game background. Make the pixel-art appearance considerably clearer than the reference while keeping the whole island scene recognizable and in the same positions.
Visual treatment: intentional square pixel clusters, clear stair-stepped silhouettes and dark pixel outlines, coherent limited color ramps with roughly 3-5 tones per material, clean broad planes on rocks and roofs, compact stylized foliage clusters, simple rhythmic pixel foam and waves. Use an apparent native grid around 640x360 enlarged sharply into the final large canvas: visible consistent pixel blocks, not tiny painterly noise. Rich polished 16-bit adventure-game background quality, with restrained dithering only on large shadow transitions. No blur, no airbrushing, no smooth gradients, no photorealistic or glossy 3D shading, no fake grain/noise pixel filter.
Composition invariants: same elevated isometric camera, entire wide island and surrounding sea in frame, same coastline and horizon; central mountain, double waterfall, pond and stream, bridge, ruined abandoned red-roof houses, garden and fences, forge/anvil and market stall, lower cave and small hooded figure at its campfire, shipwreck, offshore rocks and clouds in their original positions. The monumental tower on the mountain summit remains half ruined, with no visible entrance and no outside staircase. Preserve the empty central square and vacant smith/market workplaces; DO NOT add the selected crowd, blacksmith, seller or buyer yet. Do not add, remove or relocate landmarks. Keep the original relative proportions and framing. No captions, UI, grid lines, frame, logos or watermarks. Solid full image, no transparency or borders. Change the rendering style only.
Palette: preserve this target's BRIGHT sunny version: vivid cobalt and azure sea, emerald and lime-green foliage, warm golden paths, terracotta red roofs, purple-grey rock shadows. Unify and simplify the color ramps without making it muted.
